comment:
If your free time is severely limited (which longtime users can witness it is), using AI would enable you to provide improvements to Buckets more often to us users.

But if you go that route, don't allow AI to spit code guns blazing, use it deliberately and review what it does, and ask it to optimize its own code before you commit it.

So if AI enables you 10x productivity for Buckets, limit that to like 3x and it will still be an improvement while it won't get out of hand (for both you and us).
